scope: Graphical, document and version-integrity checks. This does not establish clinical validity, independent peer-review acceptance or submission readiness.
figure_encoding: Equal-size patient count cells use a common labelled logarithmic count scale. No variable-size bubbles. Ordinary categorical data points are circles; trend lines are solid.
visual_review: All five main and 41 supplementary figures viewed individually; all compiled main and appendix pages checked for layout, with enlarged checks of S3/S4 and affected captions.
colour_stress_tests: Grayscale and full-severity Machado 2009 protanopia/deuteranopia/tritanopia previews generated for all 46 figures. Representative multi-panel treatment/heatmap/ordinal displays inspected. This is not accessibility certification.
open_author_source_requirements: Input/reference limits are stated in Supplementary Table S5. Verified ethics and consent details remain author requirements before submission.
